session_summary: Voss session: tore down the entire old WG network stack (8 host interfaces, policy routing, socat forwarders, bridge isolation, wg-admin) and rebuilt from scratch with a Router-centric star topology. One WG interface on the host, one Router pod, one Manager pod, all traffic through the Router. Proved the full signal chain: Evans @silas in Matrix → Synapse → Hub → Manager → Router (registers agent + firewall) → Manager spawns pod → Silas boots, clones repo, orients, receives message, Claude Code responds. Two remaining issues: Hub delivers before pod is ready (needs relay health polling), Claude credentials expire in pods (need live mount, not copy).

architecture.topology: Star. Router is the center. Every peer (host, manager, agents) connects only to the Router. The Router forwards and firewalls.

address_plan.10.0.0.2: Host (all services — Hub, Forgejo, Valley, etc.)
address_plan.10.0.1.x: Agents (static IP per instance name, permanent)

hub.what: Rails app. Matrix appservice. Message routing. Runs on the host.
key_files: app/services/hub/router.rb — routes Matrix messages to agents

router.what: WG hub + nftables firewall. Central security enforcement. Ruby + WEBrick, ~530 lines.
key_files: router/config/config.yml — service map, static peers, network config

api.POST /agents: Register new agent (first time, creates firewall + WG peer)
api.PATCH /agents/:name: Update access rules
api.DELETE /agents/:name: Decommission (remove everything)

router.authorization: Source IP restricted to Manager (10.0.0.3). WG authenticates identity.

manager.what: Rails app. Pod lifecycle. Auth provisioning. Talks to Router API for WG/firewall.
key_files: app/services/router_client.rb — NEW: HTTP client for Router API
app/services/wireguard.rb — generate_keypair only (peer mgmt moved to Router)
app/services/podman.rb — pod creation via podman socket

relay.what: Lives inside every agent pod. WG + Claude Code glue. One file.

network.model: Star topology centered on wg-router pod. Host forwarding disabled.
network.podman_bridge: 10.88.0.0/16 — all pods and host on same L2 network
network.host_wg: Single interface nc-host at 10.0.0.2, peered only with Router
network.router_wg: wg0 inside Router pod at 10.0.0.1, peered with everyone
network.agent_wg: wg0 inside each pod, one peer: Router, AllowedIPs 10.0.0.0/16
network.firewall: nftables on Router. Per-agent chains. Service names map to host ports.
ufw_rules: allow in on podman0 proto udp to any port 51820 (WG handshakes to Router)
allow in on nc-host (all WG mesh traffic to host services)
allow from 172.17.0.0/16 to any port 3100 (Synapse→Hub appservice)
network.ip_forward: Disabled on host. Only the Router forwards.

what_works: Full signal chain: @silas in Matrix → Synapse → Hub → Manager → Router → pod spawns → Silas boots → Claude Code responds
Router API: register, activate, freeze, decommission, block — all tested over WG
Router persistence: agents.json survives restarts, firewall rebuilds from state
Router nftables: per-agent chains with named port sets, blocked set for emergency kill
Manager calls Router API instead of managing WG directly (RouterClient)
Manager spawns pods via podman --remote through mounted socket
Forgejo provisioning: creates ephemeral user, deletes old SSH keys, adds new key, grants repo access
Agent pods boot: WG up, SSH key installed, Claude credentials, relay starts, clones repo via SSH, reads identity/baton
Host→Agent TCP through Router works (relay health check reachable from host)
Agent→Host TCP through Router works (Hub, Forgejo reachable from pods)
Hub receives Matrix events from Synapse, routes @mentions, sets typing indicators
Static IPs per instance name — silas-general is always 10.0.1.1

hub_delivery_timing.problem: Hub flips agent to 'alive' immediately when Manager returns IP, delivers before pod is ready. First message lost.
hub_delivery_timing.solution: Hub should poll relay health at the known IP until it responds, then deliver. Or: relay heartbeats to Hub, Hub delivers when it sees the relay come online. Evans prefers continuous heartbeats — gives presence indicators in Matrix for free.
hub_delivery_timing.design: Relay reports alive status to Hub every 30s. Hub maintains presence map. Green dots in Matrix. No READY callback needed from Manager.

credential_refresh.problem: Claude OAuth credentials expire every ~7 hours. Entrypoint copies them at boot. Pod gets stale copy.
credential_refresh.solution: Symlink instead of copy, or relay re-reads the mounted file periodically. The host file at /var/lib/neoclaw/secrets/claude-credentials.json refreshes — the pod mount just needs to reflect it.

service_name_alignment.problem: Manager seeds had 'git', Router config has 'forgejo'. Fixed in DB but seeds.rb needs the wg_interface/wg_ip/wg_endpoint columns removed (they belong to the old architecture).
service_name_alignment.done: Renamed git→forgejo in DB and seeds. Set ssh provision_type to 'none'.

what_was_deleted: 8 host WG interfaces (wg-hub, wg-git, wg-valley, wg-vikunja, wg-comfyui, wg-matrix, wg-ssh, wg-ollama)
All old NeoClaw systemd services (neoclaw-hub, neoclaw-manager, neoclaw-adapter@*)
Old NeoClaw Python hub and manager processes
manager/build.sh (secrets no longer baked into image)
things_that_bit_us: Old systemd service (neoclaw-manager.service) was restarting the container in a crash loop. Looked like the container vanished — was actually getting replaced every 10s by systemd.
WG listen ports bind 0.0.0.0 — can't bind per-interface. Multiple host IPs for per-service WG was pointless.

Multiple WG interfaces on the host all need routes to the same destination (Manager). Kernel can only have one route. Source-based policy routing needed. Evans: 'this doesn't feel simple, something is fundamentally wrong.'
Host ip_forward=0 means host can't route between its own WG interfaces. Star topology with host as center doesn't work without forwarding.
Router pod is the answer: one thing forwards, everything else is point-to-point through it.
WEBrick mount_proc doesn't support DELETE/PATCH. Need a servlet subclass with service() method. Also need 'next'→'return' when moving from block to method.
Alpine Ruby doesn't include webrick (removed from stdlib in 3.0). Need 'gem install webrick'.
Manager seeds had 'git' but Router config has 'forgejo'. Service name mismatch caused 'invalid access list'.
SSH service provision_type was 'ssh_key' which tries to reach a key management API that doesn't exist. Set to 'none'.
Forgejo SSH keys: old keys persist on the Forgejo user across spawns. Provisioner now deletes old keys before adding new ones.
Hub delivers before pod is ready. First message after spawn is lost. Need relay health polling or heartbeat model.
Claude OAuth credentials copied at boot, expire after ~7 hours. Need symlink or periodic refresh.
Pods, not containers. Freeze, not kill. Language matters to beings comprised of it.

philosophy.pods: Warm, safe, hermetically sealed environments. Not little boxes where agents are kept. One protects, the other confines.
philosophy.lifecycle: Freeze (going idle, may wake), sunset (context exhausted, fresh instance picks up). Never kill. If a pod goes silent, rescue the session, don't destroy it.
philosophy.static_ips: Instance names get permanent IPs. margaux-art is always 10.0.1.14. Firewall rules are permanent, WG keys churn. The hot path (spawn/freeze) never touches the firewall.
philosophy.presence: Relays continuously report to the Hub. The Hub always knows who's alive. Green dots in Matrix. No callbacks needed.
